reference_description: Source-cited: CRCNS ieeg-1 data description v0.71 states 'The iEEG was recorded against a common intracranial reference and then transformed to bipolar channels for further analysis.' The BIDS sidecar iEEGReference is n/a; the reference location is not stated.

markers.label: SWS
markers.source: https://crcns.org/files/data/ieeg-1/crcns_ieeg-1_data_description.pdf (each five-minute interval selected as interictal slow-wave sleep; scoring by scalp EEG, EOG, EMG and video) and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenNeuroDatasets/ds003498/950e1dbfe4a065975c15a6742bb0576464f7c93b/sub-01/ses-interictalsleep/ieeg/sub-01_ses-interictalsleep_run-01_ieeg.json TaskDescription

dataset.name: interictal iEEG during slow-wave sleep with HFO markings (Zurich iEEG HFO Dataset)

limitations: Channel types are published as ECOG in channels.tsv; the CRCNS description says strips, grids and depth electrodes were used. Electrode type/anatomy is not inferred from labels.
No electrode coordinates are published in this BIDS tree; no spatial map is possible from this source.
The vmrk stimulus markers and events.tsv rows are HFOs from the authors' automated detector (Burnos et al. 2016), not manual gold-standard markings and not BrainToolkit output.
Reference location is not stated; only the common-intracranial-reference statement is cited.
Participant sub-01: TLE, ILAE 1 per participants.tsv; outcome is not used for any inference here.
